data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): Modified-test RED-marker bookkeeping — task-1 takes an existing passing test file to a RED state until task-6 lands. Add a comment marker near each updated test function: '# RED: task-1, expected GREEN after task-6 (71d4-be7e-d58b-4dce)'. If the project's .test-index requires explicit RED registration for modified-to-fail tests (check plugins/dso/docs/HOOKS-REFERENCE.md test-gate section), follow that protocol; otherwise the inline comment is the documentation channel for the next sub-agent / reviewer.
